verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only offers a generic claim of supporting 'over a dozen platforms' and detailed docs/GitHub references for the JavaScript SDK (rollbar.js), with no mention of iOS, Android, or NDK crash-capture SDKs, nor any documentation of device, OS, or app-version context fields for native mobile crashes. Missing for 10: iOS/Android/NDK SDK docs, native crash symbolication, device/OS metadata capture, app-version tagging for mobile crashes.
